dynamic_line: My cave got swarmed by some of those bees, the ones the size of dogs.  I took out a few with a stick, but pretty quick I realized it was either head for the hills or get stuck like a pig.  The rest is history.
//: TK: In a future iteration, this evacuee might give you directions to a hive.

dynamic_line: Yeah, I'm sure you've seen them, they're everywhere.  Like something out of a scary story.  Some of the others in the cave got stung, it was no joke.  I didn't stick around to see what the lasting effect was though.  I'm not ashamed to admit I ran like a <freaking> chicken.

responses.text: But bees aren't usually aggressive… do you mean wasps?
